	type = character_event
	title = eir.0100.t
	desc = eir.0100.desc
	theme = war
	cooldown = { years = 100 }

	trigger = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		current_year >= 867
		current_year <= 940
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_hist_0867 }
		eir_has_coast_trigger = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0100.a
		trigger = {
			OR = {
			prowess >= 8
			martial >= 10
			}
		}
		stress_impact = {
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		add_prestige = 75

		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {

			zealous = minor_stress_impact_gain

		}
		add_gold = medium_gold_value
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_cattle_rich_modifier years = 8 }
		set_global_variable = eir_hist_0867
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0100.c
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_foreign_lords_modifier years = 4 }
		set_global_variable = eir_hist_0867
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0100.d
		set_global_variable = eir_hist_0867
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
	}
}
